A large round window at the far end of the room shows a bright harbor view. (3) The woman walks into the room and sits on one of the beds, bouncing slightly to demonstrate the comfort while smiling and pointing at the view outside. (4) She enters a small, brightly lit bathroom, showing the white toilet and then moving into a glass-enclosed shower stall. She picks up a handheld showerhead and laughs while interacting with someone behind the camera.
